title: Crazy Man
body:
Description

NPC added in v 1.55.0. He talks about ducks. This was a reference to the live event where the old resource hub and desert were destroyed.

Dialogues

  • EPIK DUCK… EVERYWHERE…
  • THE VISIONS.. EPIC DUCK VISIONS… GAHHHHHHHHHHHHH
  • THE PEBBLE... KNOWS... OF… THE...... DUCK..........
  • EVERY WHERE I GO... I SEE DUCK... EPIK... DUCK...
  • THE QUACKENING IS COMING! I FEEL IT!
  • THE PROPHECY FORETOLD OF AN EPIK DUCK...
  • THE MIGHTIEST OF GODS BOW DOWN BEFORE TEN EPICK DUCK...
  • RUN... OR ELSE TEH EPIK DUCK WILL KILL YOU!!
  • TEH EPIK DUCK IS COMING!!!!
  • DUCK VS. WORLD... WHO PREVAILS?
  • WHEN ALL SEEMS LOST, TEH EPIK DUCK WILL TAKE MORE
  • WHEN THE MOON RISES, SO DOES THE EPIK DUCK....
